items.title: Computerized clairvoyance: psychics push back against AI-generated readings
items.summary: Human practitioners warn computer-generated offerings lack the empathy and connection central to divination“This journey isn’t just about algorithms or data,” an AI psychic named Urban Mystic recently told me. The chatbot, featuring an AI-generated profile photo of a smiling woman surrounded by palm trees, also said I will get married soon, that I have a pink aura and that I may have been an herbalist in a past life.“It’s about connecting on a soulful level,” the chatbot said.</

items.title: GitHub Launches npm Firewall to Block Malicious Packages Before Installation
items.summary:
GitHub has announced that it's introducing a new package firewall as a preview to block installation of suspicious npm packages during installation time.

"The firewall inspects both metadata requests and package downloads for signs of malicious activity, acting as an install-time policy gate," GitHub said.

The feature, which currently supports only npm packages, is available in public preview
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
